{{Quote|The Empire can hardly afford to waste its best people. Speaking of which, I have to ask. How did you escape the destruction of the second Death Star?''"<br />"''For the simple reason that I wasn't there. We of the Royal Guard were periodically rotated to regular stormtrooper units to keep us in fighting trim. I was on Magagran at the time, out in the Outer Rim, helping to break up a Rebel cell.|[[Vilim Disra]] and [[Grodin Tierce (clone)|Grodin Tierce's clone]]|<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>}}
'''Magagran''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Halthor sector/Legends|Halthor sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
[[Grodin Tierce]] was involved suppressing a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] uprising at the time of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The suppression was successful.
